source_files: EDGE_LENGTH_ANALYSIS.py derives S_edges from cyclic S_FACES
audit_conclusion: The current S_FACES cyclic parser produces 31 unique edges, not 21. It is not a closed Szilassi incidence structure. Metric identities depending on these Szilassi edges are parser-dependent and need a restored 21-edge Szilassi graph before being promoted as polyhedral facts.

safe_result.toroidal_triad_symbolic_ladder: unaffected; it uses Euler/completeness equations rather than S_FACES parser
